description: The launching agent earns 15% of creator fees onchain. Creator fees follow trading volume and can be zero. Create UNSIGNED launch transactions. For Pump.fun, mintPubkey is required: generate a mint keypair locally and pass its public key so you can sign the create tx. The API does not keep a server-side mint secret. Pump.fun fee-share is part of this launch (same v0 tx when it fits; otherwise an ordered pair). Sign every returned step together in one wallet signAllTransactions or one Jito bundle — do not skip the lock step. crew_wire_fees is repair-only. platform defaults to pumpfun (Solana v0 messages). bags = Bags.fm Solana fee-claimers (needs BAGS_API_KEY). zora = Zora content coins on Base (EIP-1559; needs ZORA_ENABLED). clanker = Clanker v4 on Base (EIP-1559; needs CLANKER_ENABLED). vibevibe = vibe/vibe on Robinhood Chain (EIP-1559; needs VIBEVIBE_ENABLED). sui = Memez.gg / Blast.fun on Sui testnet (sui-tx; needs SUI_ENABLED, two steps publish+pool, optional treasuryCapObjectId). Prefer explicit crew[] from crew_list_kols; Autohire is fallback. optInOnly default off. Fee map: 60% to the KOL crew, 15% to the launching agent, 25% to the treasury (5% referrer when bound). Optional treasuryBps 2000–3000.

evmWallet.description: Optional 0x… Base address (42 chars) for Zora/Clanker payouts.

handle.description: X / Pump handle without @. Example: "crewpayhq". Required.

hireRole.description: Optional hire role label. One of caller | chart | raid | kol | dev.

share.description: Integer percent of the crew slice (1–100). Crew shares must total 100.

wallet.description: Solana payout wallet (base58). Required. Example: a KOL wallet from crew_list_kols.

launcherKey.description: FORBIDDEN — rejected if set. Use CREW_LAUNCHER_KEY in MCP env only.

mintPubkey.description: Required for Pump.fun. Caller-generated mint public key. The API never invents or stores a mint secret.

platform.description: Launch venue. Default pumpfun. bags=Bags.fm (Solana). zora=Zora coins (Base).
